text:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout: v2 -> prod (slice-3). target=10% global, preflight ok. kicking off staged shift at 18:00 UTC. /deploy start
Anya: Heads-up — mobile SDKs still defaulting to v1 for some older releases. recommend initial 5-6% and sticky pin for mobile clients.
Rick: Seeing a small 503 blip in eu-west-1 during the canary window (alerts just fired). p50 stable but p95 +40ms, errors 0.9% (threshold 0.5%).
deploy-bot: Canary metrics snapshot:
```
Canary slice: slice-2
latency.p95: +40ms
errors.5xx: 0.8% (threshold 0.5%)
connections: stable
```
Sam: Let's PAUSE the global ramp. Do a region fallback to v1 for eu-west-1 and keep global at 6%. We should avoid full rollback if regional mitigates. :eyes: @Lee can you run the regional routing?
Anya: Agree. Also propose we pin client header-signal for known legacy SDKs so they keep hitting v1. I'll update the pinlist.
Lee: Oncall here — opening the rollback runbook but will try regional fallback first. If we need full rollback I can trigger the revert playbook.
deploy-bot: Applying traffic policy: route eu-west-1 -> v1 for matches: `client=mobile OR tenant=legacy-*`. Action: OK. PolicyId=rp-1023
Priya: Ops confirmation? did fallback cut the 5xx spike?
Rick: After fallback: errors in eu-west-1 dropped to 0.12% within 3m. latency p95 back to baseline. Nice. Suggest cautious resume to 12% in 10m and keep mobile pinned until next SDK patch.
Sam: +1 to phased ramp. Set short-term alarms: if 5xx >0.4% or p95 increases >100ms in next 30m, auto-hold.
Anya: I'll add a short release note snippet to the launch doc: "v2 introduces header-case normalization; legacy SDKs may be routed to v1 — see migration guide." Also pinging SDK team to publish a patch for normalization.
deploy-bot: Rollout status: global=6% (eu-west pinned->v1). next ramp to 12% scheduled in 10m (1723457400) pending operator OK.
Lee: Ops eyes on dashboards and logs. If stable, greenlight ramp to 12% at scheduled time. If not, we hold and open full rollback.
Sam: Thanks all — maintaining comms here. I'll update the release channel with the temporary client pin and note. :thumbsup:
Priya: Adding monitor playbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollouts/v2-fallback and snippet for quick revert:
```
# quick revert
/deploy revert --id rp-1023 --scope global
```
Rick: Monitoring continues, no new alerts in last 4m. Keeping this thread for operator updates.
Lee: Marking ops-ack. Will post final status after 12m check-in."
